pdfs.name: schweiger_zeitouni.pdf
pdfs.title: The maximum of log-correlated Gaussian fields in random environment

independent_inspection.finding: Near-one quenched maximum convergence is proved. The all-p part of Theorem 1.9 verifies A.2-A.4 and B.2-B.3; A.1 and B.1 retain the near-one restriction. The covariance is the grounded combinatorial inverse, equivalently the counting-measure VSRW Green kernel.

pdfs.name: andres.pdf
pdfs.title: Scaling limit of the discrete Gaussian free field with degenerate random conductances

independent_inspection.finding: Scaling limits do not prove maxima convergence. The displayed conjecture assumes positive conductances almost surely. The surrounding summary must not be used to drop the near-one restriction of the cited primary theorem.

pdfs.name: nonlinear.pdf
pdfs.title: Scaling limits for nonlinear functionals of the discrete Gaussian free field with degenerate random conductances

independent_inspection.finding: Nonlinear/Sobolev scaling limits do not prove maxima convergence. The authors identify an unsuitable leading upper-bound constant and missing tail control for the random heat-kernel scale.
